## Implementation Decisions

- Home V2 is a separate preview homepage track and must not replace `/` yet.
- The primary public homepage audience is Swiss parents.
- Student, tutor, parent-app, and admin audiences remain role-specific outside the public homepage story.
- The positioning filter is 70% Swiss private-school / high-end education service and 30% modern learning product.
- The preferred primary CTA direction is `Start learning`.
- AI should not be a hero-level concept.
